objectives.label: Net profit
objectives.definition: Sum of closed-trade profit after commission; excludes open P&L.

objectives.label: Win rate
objectives.definition: Winning closed trades divided by all closed trades, including breakevens.

objectives.label: Expectancy
objectives.definition: Mean net profit per closed trade, including losses and breakevens.

objectives.label: Profit factor
objectives.definition: Gross winning profit divided by gross losing profit, both after commission. Undefined without losses.

objectives.label: Payoff ratio
objectives.definition: Average net winning trade divided by the absolute average net losing trade. Requires wins and losses.

objectives.label: Risk of ruin (estimate)
objectives.definition: Infinite-horizon diffusion estimate of losing the declared amount from starting capital. Assumes independent, stationary, fixed-size net trade P&L; ignores intratrade losses and margin.

objectives.label: Maximum drawdown
objectives.definition: Largest equity drawdown under the tester's intrabar TradingView convention, including an open trade at the end.

objectives.label: Consecutive losses
objectives.definition: Longest streak of losing closed trades in execution order. A win or breakeven resets the streak.

objectives.label: Sharpe ratio
objectives.definition: Monthly marked-to-market excess return divided by population standard deviation, using 2% annual risk-free rate; not annualized.

objectives.label: Sortino ratio
objectives.definition: Monthly marked-to-market excess return divided by downside deviation about the risk-free rate; not annualized.

objectives.label: R-multiple
objectives.definition: Mean net trade profit / initial stop risk in dollars. Risk is actual fill to initial stop, before costs. Requires positive initial risk for every closed trade; R standard deviation and mean / standard deviation describe consistency.

objectives.label: Maximum adverse excursion (MAE)
objectives.definition: Mean of each closed trade's maximum adverse price excursion in dollars, before commission; only the exposed intrabar path counts.

objectives.label: Maximum favorable excursion (MFE)
objectives.definition: Mean of each closed trade's maximum favorable price excursion in dollars, before commission; only the exposed intrabar path counts. Unrealized opportunity, not realized profit.
